CustomField.description: JCRC formal greeting for the household or organization. JCRC's own field; NPSP household naming and its npo02 greeting fields are not used for this. Rules: titled person first (Hon./Judge/Amb. > military > clergy > Dr. > Prof.), "Mr. and Mrs. First and First Last" for same last name, "Drs." when both are Dr. Jason Ott, 2026-11-12.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Formal greeting for letters and envelopes, e.g. "Mr. and Mrs. Michael and Ruth Slade" or "Dr. Cheryl Saban and Mr. Haim Saban".
CustomField.label: Formal Greeting
